entities.name: Calvin
entities.description: A rapper and musician, one of the two friends in this conversation. In March 2023 he moved into a mansion in Japan, toured with Frank Ocean through 2023, released an album on 11 September 2023 and kept planning visits to Boston to see Dave. Dave calls him Cal.

entities.name: Dave
entities.description: An automotive engineer in Boston and Calvin's friend. He opened his own car maintenance shop in 2023, restores classic cars, joined a rock band in June 2023, was picked for a car modification workshop in August 2023 and took up photography in the autumn.

entities.name: Frank Ocean
entities.description: The well-known artist Calvin tours and records with. Calvin says they met at a music festival — in Tokyo by one telling, in August 2022 by another — clicked, and went on to record together at Calvin's mansion.

entities.name: Dave's father
entities.description: Dave's father, who worked on cars with him when he was a boy, spent one summer restoring an old car with him, and took him to his first car show when he was ten — the outing Dave credits for his career.

entities.name: Calvin's father
entities.description: Calvin's father, with whom he took childhood road trips; they sang along to Tupac and Dr. Dre's 'California Love', the song Calvin names as the one that still makes him smile.

entities.name: Calvin's old high school friend
entities.description: The friend Calvin freestyled with as a teenager, referred to as 'a high school friend' and 'my old high school buddy'. He showed Calvin sights in Boston on 24 October 2023 and Calvin invited him to a Boston performance reported on 13 November 2023; Calvin credits his positivity with making a difference to his journey.

entities.name: The young musicians Calvin supports
entities.description: A group rather than one person: young musicians from a music program whom Calvin mentors, makes beats for and expects to support for a long time. None of them is named; Calvin described them on 13 November 2023 as ambitious and inspiring.

entities.name: Tokyo
entities.description: The Japanese city where Calvin attended a music festival, performed on the Frank Ocean tour, and photographed the night skyline on 15 May 2023. Calvin names Shibuya Crossing and Shinjuku as the spots he wants to see; Dave has never been and hopes to go.

entities.name: Japan
entities.description: The country Calvin moved to in 2023, having never been there before 23 March 2023. His mansion, his studio and a small mountain town he means to visit are there; Dave has never been and wants to go.

entities.name: Boston
entities.description: The city where Dave lives, runs his car shop and photographs the skyline and clock tower. Calvin planned a visit there through most of 2023, said on 9 June 2023 he had never been and on 29 October 2023 that he had been a few years back, and finally performed and went to a gala there in the autumn.

entities.name: Miami
entities.description: The city where Calvin shot the video for his new album, on a beach he picked for its visuals, starting over the weekend of 26–27 August 2023.

entities.name: San Francisco
entities.description: The city where Dave attended a car restoration and modification workshop. He reported going on 14 August 2023 and said on 2 September 2023 that he had come back the day before with new insights on car modification.

entities.name: Detroit
entities.description: The city where Dave attended a conference he said he learned a lot from, reported on 25 October 2023.

entities.name: Calvin's mansion in Japan
entities.description: The house Calvin moved into on 23 March 2023, shown off as 'my new mansion' and later called 'my Japanese house'. It looks out over a city skyline, he converted part of it into a recording studio, recorded a song there with Frank Ocean, and threw an album party there in late October 2023.

properties.aliases: my new mansion; my Japanese house; the Japanese mansion

entities.name: The park Dave goes to
entities.description: The park with a lake and boats that Dave has spent a lot of time in since early 2023 and recommended to Calvin on 23 March 2023; he strolls there, arranged regular walks with friends there, and later photographed a waterfall in a nearby park.

entities.name: Dave's car maintenance shop
entities.description: The car maintenance shop Dave owns, which he announced opening on 1 May 2023 and on 16 May 2023 said he had opened the previous week, celebrating with friends. It handles everything from routine servicing to full classic-car restorations, and in mid-October 2023 lost a long-chased deal to a competing shop.

entities.name: Dave's rock band
entities.description: The rock band Dave joined, reported on 21 June 2023; he plays guitar in it, had been a fan of it before joining, jammed with them on the night of 14 September 2023 and showed Calvin the band's guitar logo in November 2023.

entities.name: The car modification workshop
entities.description: The car modification workshop Dave was picked for on 11 August 2023 and called a dream come true. He learned engine swaps, suspension work and body modification there, and connected it with the San Francisco car workshop he attended the same month.

entities.name: Aerosmith
entities.description: The band Dave names as his favourite act at the Boston music festival he went to over the weekend of 18–19 March 2023; it was the first time he had seen them live, and he did not meet them afterwards.

entities.name: The Fireworks
entities.description: The band that headlined the music festival Dave came back from on 15 October 2023; he described their set and the main stage as unreal.

entities.name: Calvin's album
entities.description: The album Calvin worked on through 2023: he met its creative team on 8 June 2023, started shooting a video for it in Miami over the weekend of 26–27 August 2023, released it on 11 September 2023 to a reception he called overwhelming, threw a party for it at his Japanese house in late October 2023 — and on 29 October 2023 said an album was almost finished.

entities.name: California Love
entities.description: The Tupac and Dr. Dre song Calvin and his father sang along to on a childhood road trip; on 22 September 2023 Calvin named it as the song from his childhood that always makes him smile, and Dave called it a classic.

entities.name: Ratatouille
entities.description: The Disney film Calvin named on 15 September 2023 as one of his favourites, after showing Dave its poster; both of them liked its lesson about following your dreams whatever anyone says.

entities.name: Dave's car modification blog
entities.description: The blog about car modifications Dave started, reported on 2 November 2023, as a way of sharing his passion. Readers ask him for advice, and a post about a car he made 'look like a beast' prompted others to start their own DIY projects.

entities.name: Calvin's Ferrari
entities.description: The red luxury sports car Calvin said on 26 March 2023 he had just got, a lifelong dream; he drives it to relax, was in a minor accident in it on 16 June 2023, had it repaired, and took it for a stressful service on 3 August 2023. He named it as a Ferrari from August 2023 onward and said on 15 October 2023 that he had got a new Ferrari the week before, which this record treats as the same possession unless a second car is stated.

entities.name: Calvin's custom octopus guitar
entities.description: A guitar custom-made for Calvin by a Japanese artist friend, carrying an octopus design that stands for his love of art and the sea, and finished with a shiny purple glow he asked for to match his style. He calls it one of his favourites and a reminder of his friendships.

entities.name: Calvin's diamond pendant necklace
entities.description: A gold necklace with a diamond pendant that Calvin was given by another artist; he showed it to Dave on 1 May 2023 and called it a reminder of why he keeps hustling as a musician.

entities.name: Dave's vintage Ford Mustang
entities.description: The vintage Ford Mustang Dave found in a junkyard in bad shape and restored through 2023 — the car project he showed as finished on 15 September 2023, whose engine made a worrying noise on 22 September 2023, whose restored state he photographed on 4 October 2023, and which he said on 29 October 2023 he had just finished. The mentions of 'my car project' from August 2023 onward are joined to it here.

entities.name: The classic car Dave restored in 2022
entities.description: A classic car Dave restored in 2022, which he described on 1 May 2023 as a labour of love and showed the rebuilt engine of; on 23 October 2023 he said he had sold it to a collector and moved on to a new project.

entities.name: Dave's vintage camera
entities.description: The vintage camera Dave bought in November 2023 and showed Calvin on 17 November 2023; he says it captures special moments clearly and uses it for the nature photography he has taken up.

entities.name: Making and performing music
entities.description: Calvin's work and his purpose: writing and recording, studio sessions, collaborations with other artists, and live performance, which he describes as an absolute high and as his form of therapy. Dave shares it at an amateur level through his rock band.

entities.name: Restoring and modifying cars
entities.description: Dave's craft and his living: taking a broken-down car and making it run again. He has done it since he was ten, calls it therapy and a sense of purpose, and by 2023 does it professionally at his own shop. Calvin also says working on cars calms him.

entities.name: Photography
entities.description: The hobby Dave took up in the autumn of 2023, shooting Boston skylines, a clock tower at sunset, sunsets, beaches, waves and a waterfall; he calls it a creative outlet and bought a vintage camera for it in November 2023.

entities.name: Walking in the parks
entities.description: Dave's way of unwinding: weekend walks and strolls in Boston's parks, which he says recharge him for the week, and from July 2023 regular walks he arranged with friends.

entities.name: Calvin's tour with Frank Ocean
entities.description: The tour Calvin performed on with Frank Ocean. He spoke of finishing it as early as 20 April 2023, said he had toured in Tokyo in late May, said on 14 August 2023 that it ended with a show in Japan, called it ended on 31 August 2023, and then on 19 October 2023 said he had started touring with Frank Ocean — the conversation gives the tour several endings and a later beginning.

entities.name: Turning the Japanese mansion into a recording studio
entities.description: Calvin's project to convert his mansion in Japan into a recording studio — a space of his own to create with other artists, which he called his sanctuary. He showed progress on 21 July 2023 and by 22 August 2023 had recorded a song with Frank Ocean in the finished studio.
